criteria.requirement: Repair textdistance.utils.words_combinations(f,*texts) for actual built-in distances and arbitrary numeric callables without assuming a nonexistent equality attribute. Add explicit direction distance/similarity, max_permutations positive call budget and truncate=False policy. Preserve full word counts by default; opt-in truncation is explicit. Generate unique permutations for duplicate words and preflight the whole Cartesian-product budget before any scoring; reject insufficient budgets rather than return a partial optimum. Empty documents have one empty permutation, no documents reject, bad direction/nonfinite/bool scores reject. Evaluate multi-document callables correctly, propagate their real errors and document factorial limits.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
